click: a short clean click of a button being pressed
impact: a huge low thud for a movie trailer
a massive hit with a rumbling tail
pop: a popping sound like a bubble bursting
typing_key: one key being pressed on a computer keyboard
a single keystroke on a mechanical keyboard
whoosh_fast: a quick swoosh as something flies past
a short sharp swoosh of air
